title: Names hold values

blocks.md:
## A name is a sticky note

`total = 3 + 4` does the sum, then sticks the result on the name `total`. `print(total)` shows what the name holds. Printing a literal `7` without a name skips the idea.

hintLadder.md: Compute 3 + 4 into a name, then print the name.
The last line should print a name, not a hardcoded 7 only.

description: A name holds a value you can use again later.
